call connect [GT alt-azimuth base]
@ port baud=9600 data=8 parity=none stop=1 flow=none
> :e1\r
< =020780\r
  -> Err(InvalidDevice("Sky-Watcher GT, motor controller firmware 2.07 is an alt-azimuth mount (mount code 0x80); Skotiq drives Sky-Watcher equatorial mounts"))
  connected=false
== no site ==
call connect [no site]
@ port baud=9600 data=8 parity=none stop=1 flow=none
> :e1\r
< =030700\r
> :a1\r
< =00B289\r
> :b1\r
< =A7FD00\r
> :a2\r
< =00B289\r
> :b2\r
< =A7FD00\r
> :f1\r
< =100\r
> :f2\r
< =100\r
> :j1\r
< =000080\r
> :j2\r
< =000080\r
> :F1\r
< =\r
> :F2\r
< =\r
> :E2806CA2\r
< =\r
> :f1\r
< =101\r
  -> Ok(())
call get_coordinates
  -> Err(InvalidParameter("The Sky-Watcher mount points by the observing site and the computer clock: set the observing site in Settings > Location"))
call slew_to_coordinates(5.5, 20.0)
  -> Err(InvalidParameter("The Sky-Watcher mount points by the observing site and the computer clock: set the observing site in Settings > Location"))
call set_tracking(true)
  -> Err(InvalidParameter("The Sky-Watcher mount points by the observing site and the computer clock: set the observing site in Settings > Location"))
call get_tracking
> :f1\r
< =101\r
  -> Ok(false)
call park
> :K1\r
< =\r
> :f1\r
< =101\r
> :K2\r
< =\r
> :f2\r
< =101\r
> :j1\r
< =000080\r
> :j2\r
< =806CA2\r
> :f1\r
< =101\r
> :f2\r
< =101\r
  -> Ok(())
call is_parked
  -> Ok(true)
